reason: Gemfile.lock:22 pins active_model_serializers 0.8.3, which decides whether to include an attribute only by calling `include_<attr>?`. `include_website_name` at app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:153 has no trailing '?', so nothing ever calls it and `website_name` (declared at :43) is always serialized, as nil when there is no website.
